Builddrone 0.5.4 switches GitHub Actions PyPI publishing from a long-lived
API token to Trusted Publishing. Tagged releases now authenticate with a
short-lived OIDC token from GitHub instead of `PYPI_API_TOKEN`.

**Documentation:** https://nepitwin.github.io/Builddrone/latest/

---

## Publishing

### Trusted Publishing for tagged releases

The `publish` job in `.github/workflows/workflow.yml` now uses
`pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish` with `id-token: write`. On a version tag it
exchanges a GitHub OIDC identity for a short-lived PyPI token and uploads
the built distributions.

The job no longer reads `secrets.PYPI_API_TOKEN`. After this release
succeeds, that repository secret can be removed.

The workflow filename remains `workflow.yml`. That name must match the
GitHub Actions publisher registered for `builddrone` on PyPI.
